# Review — PAN-5586
## Verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED — tests/lib/model-fallback.test.ts still asserts the old Google model counts; 3 tests fail (AC-1 unmet, CI test shard will go red)
## Context
- Run ID: agent-pan-5586-review-e6b2e699

## Blocking Findings
### [correctness / requirements] `model-fallback.test.ts` not updated for the three new Google ids — `tests/lib/model-fallback.test.ts:166`
- Severity: ! (MUST)
- Classification / requirement scope: implementation defect (missed work-item step); in_pr_scope
- Trigger and changed-code connection: the PR adds `gemini-4-neon`, `gemini-4-carbon` and `gemini-4-hydrogen` to `MODEL_PROVIDERS` in `src/lib/model-fallback.ts` (lines 75-77). `getModelsByProvider('google')` and `getAvailableModels()` derive from that table, so their counts grow by 3. The PRD's WI-1 step 5 explicitly lists the required test edits (`toHaveLength(11)` → `14` at line 166, `toBe(46)` → `49` at line 405, `toBe(20)` → `23` at line 441, plus comments and `toContain` / `getModelProvider` / `getFallbackModel` assertions). None were made; the file is not in the diff.
- Expected / observed / impact: expected the file to pass with the new counts. Observed 3 failures:
  - `getModelsByProvider > should return all Google models`: expected length 11, got 14
  - `getAvailableModels > should return all models when all providers enabled`: expected 46, got 49
  - `getAvailableModels > should include Google models when Google enabled`: expected 20, got 23
  This file is in the normal `tests/lib` suite, so the CI `test-shard` jobs will fail on this HEAD. AC-1 names this file explicitly and is unmet.
- Evidence: `npx vitest run tests/lib/model-fallback.test.ts` at HEAD e6b2e699 → 3 failed. The new `model-capabilities.test.ts` case already asserts `getModelsByProvider('google')` has length 14, so the two test files now contradict each other.
- Fix: apply WI-1 step 5 to `tests/lib/model-fallback.test.ts`: change line 166 to `toHaveLength(14)` and add `toContain` for the three ids; line 405 → `toBe(49)` with comment `// 13 Anthropic + 15 OpenAI + 10 Google + 11 Kimi`; line 441 → `toBe(23)` with comment `// 13 Anthropic + 10 current Google`; add `getModelProvider(id) === 'google'` near line 96 and `getFallbackModel` expectations near line 326. Then rerun the AC-1 command.

## Non-blocking Findings
- `~` [requirements] Capability-row `notes` strings in `src/lib/model-capability-additions.ts` (Neon line ~364, Carbon ~390, Hydrogen ~416) are much shorter than the PRD's WI-1 text. They drop release dates, output caps (Carbon's 32,768 non-streaming cap), thinking defaults, caching and pricing details, which the Argon row records. The PRD also asked for inline `costPer1MTokens` price comments. No behavior depends on `notes`, so this is advisory. Restoring the PRD text would keep the matrix self-documenting, and PAN-4555's follow-up comment expects to edit Carbon's notes.
- `?` [validation] `tests/lib/ohmypi-models.test.ts > provisions the dashscope provider…` fails on this host only because the shell exports `DASHSCOPE_BASE_URL=https://dashscope-us…`. With the variable unset, all 7 tests pass. This is pre-existing and host-environmental, and it is unrelated to this PR.
- Spec note: the PR body should record the deviation from the issue body that the PRD calls out (Hydrogen also supports xhigh). The code follows the official page, which is correct.

### Dimensions
- Correctness: data-table additions are consistent across every lookup site. The one defect is the stale count assertions in model-fallback.test.ts.
- Security: not applicable. These are static model tables, so no trust boundary or input handling changed.
- Performance: not applicable. The change adds constant entries to small arrays and maps.
- Requirements/UX: FR-1 to FR-9 are implemented. AC-1 is unmet because of the blocker.

- Frontend: `npx vitest run src/components/Settings/__tests__/gemini-qwen-glm-catalog.test.ts`: 6 passed.
- `npm run lint:docs`: passed.
- CI (`gh pr checks 5590`) at HEAD e6b2e699: test shards, build, lint-group (core/effect/skills) and test-e2e are **pending**, so they are unverified. `overdeck/test` (typecheck + lint gate) passed.
- `npm run lint:effect-diagnostics`: not run. The change adds no Effect code, only static model tables. CI `lint-group (effect)` is pending.

## What to do

1. Read each thread (open its link, or the code at the path and line).
2. If you agree with a finding, fix it.
3. If you reject a finding, reply on its thread with your reason:
   `gh api repos/eltmon/overdeck/pulls/5590/comments/<thread id>/replies -f body="<reason>"`
4. If you changed code: run the quality gates on what you touched, commit, push, then run `pan review request PAN-5586 -m "CodeRabbit <thread ids>: <what you changed>"`.
   If you only replied, you are done.
5. If PR #5590 has already merged when you read this, stop: after the merge Overdeck files a follow-up issue
   for every thread with no reply, no later commit to its file, and no re-review request naming its thread id.
